channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Isaiah Canaan | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Isaiah Canaan from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Devin Booker on Isaiah Canaan
item.description:
“Isaiah is a guy I’ve known from high school. He’s from Mississippi, also. He comes in here, fights every day, comes in here and earns a spot. To take a tough break like this, it hurts. It hurt me.”

Devin Booker on Isaiah Canaan, Feb 1, 2018. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Isaiah Canaan
item.description:
Dirk Nowitzki on the Isaiah Canaan injury:

“That was unbelievable. I was right there. ...Once I turned around I obviously saw his foot, and you get sick to your stomach. He's a young guy who is competing for a spot in this league. That's heartbreaking.”

Dirk Nowitzki on Isaiah Canaan, Feb 1, 2018. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Isaiah Canaan
item.description:
“Isaiah did nothing wrong, but we're obviously focused on the big picture. We're having to think down the road. We need to preserve all our flexibility. Unless someone is currently, actively on the floor or in the plan for it, hard to keep him on the roster.”

Daryl Morey on Isaiah Canaan, Oct 28, 2017. Source: Houston Chronicle.

item.title: Mark Bartelstein on Isaiah Canaan
item.description:
Mark Bartelstein:

“While we're disappointed, we understand it. If there's not an opportunity for Isaiah to play, they're so tight up against it, it, put them in a tough situation. They want to stay in close contact where if something were to happen with the roster and they have a need, I know he's the first guy they'll look at.”

Mark Bartelstein on Isaiah Canaan, Oct 28, 2017. Source: Houston Chronicle.

item.title: Chris Paul on Isaiah Canaan
item.description:
Chris Paul:

“Isaiah (Canaan) is 1 of those guys, if he was on a team where it was like his team, he would be even better than he is already. You guys are lucky to have him here, especially in the backup role.”

Chris Paul on Isaiah Canaan, Nov 28, 2014. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.
